metadata.question: Did Lake Menindee, Australia shrink from February 2, 2019 to May 14, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Lake Menindee, Australia (approximately -32.4°S, 142.4°E) - Dates: February 2, 2019 and May 14, 2021 - Collection: Sentinel-2 (10m resolution, good for water detection) or Landsat 8 - Method: Calculate water surface area using water indices (NDWI or MNDWI) 2. Masking strategy: - Need to mask clouds to get accurate water measurements - Use QA60 band for Sentinel-2 cloud masking - Calculate water extent using NDWI or MNDWI threshold 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Lake could legitimately have 0 water area (dried up) - this is a valid measurement - C1: No images available for one or both dates - C2: Images exist but all pixels masked (heavy clouds) - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - Compare 2019 vs 2021 water area: if 2021 < 2019, answer A (shrunk), else B (did not shrink) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const lakeMenindee = ee.Geometry.Point([142.4, -32.4]).buffer(15000); // 15km buffer around lake center const date1 = '2019-02-02'; const date2 = '2021-05-14'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } function addWaterIndex(image) { const mndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('MNDWI'); return image.addBands(mndwi); } // Get images for 2019 let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(lakeMenindee) .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(15, 'day')) .map(maskS2clouds) .map(addWaterIndex); const size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Images found: ${size1}`); if (size1 === 0) { // Fallback to Landsat 8 col1 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(lakeMenindee) .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(15, 'day')) .map(function(img) { const mndwi = img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3', 'SR_B6']).rename('MNDWI'); return img.addBands(mndwi); }); const size1_l8 = await col1.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Landsat fallback: ${size1_l8}`); if (size1_l8 === 0) { console.log("No data for 2019."); console.log("C1"); return; } } // Get images for 2021 let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(lakeMenindee) .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(15, 'day')) .map(maskS2clouds) .map(addWaterIndex); const size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2021 Images found: ${size2}`); if (size2 === 0) { // Fallback to Landsat 8 col2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(lakeMenindee) .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(15, 'day')) .map(function(img) { const mndwi = img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3', 'SR_B6']).rename('MNDWI'); return img.addBands(mndwi); }); const size2_l8 = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2021 Landsat fallback: ${size2_l8}`); if (size2_l8 === 0) { console.log("No data for 2021."); console.log("C1"); return; } } // 3. Processing - Create median composites and detect water const img1 = col1.median(); const img2 = col2.median(); const water1 = img1.select('MNDWI').gt(0.3); const water2 = img2.select('MNDWI').gt(0.3); // 4. Calculate water area const pixelArea = ee.Image.pixelArea(); const stats1 = await water1.multiply(pixelArea).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: lakeMenindee, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2 = await water2.multiply(pixelArea).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: lakeMenindee, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const area1 = stats1.MNDWI || 0; const area2 = stats2.MNDWI || 0; // Check valid pixel counts const count1 = await water1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: lakeMenindee, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const count2 = await water2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: lakeMenindee, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Water area: ${(area1/1e6).toFixed(2)} km², Valid pixels: ${count1.MNDWI || 0}`); console.log(`2021 Water area: ${(area2/1e6).toFixed(2)} km², Valid pixels: ${count2.MNDWI || 0}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (!count1.MNDWI || !count2.MNDWI) { console.log("No valid pixels after masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (area1 === null || area2 === null || isNaN(area1) || isNaN(area2)) { console.log("Calculation failed."); console.log("C3"); return; } const shrinkage = area1 - area2; const percentChange = ((shrinkage / area1) * 100).toFixed(1); console.log(`Change: ${(shrinkage/1e6).toFixed(2)} km² (${percentChange}%)`); if (area2 < area1) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
